notes.title: Sidestep Legends 1.0 release!
notes.notes:
I am pleased to announce that my game Sidestep Legends is now fully released! It is a moba-inspired action roguelike about dodging spells and killing minions. It has some similarities with Dextram, but is more intense with more advanced controls. But if you enjoyed Dextram you might enjoy this one as well. Check it out below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2077590/Sidestep_Legends/

notes.title: Bug fixes and small performance improvements
notes.notes:
Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed music not playing on some machines, this fix required going back to an older window backend resulting in your screen setting being reset. Sorry for that
[*] Fixed so enemies does not try to spawn outside game area in waves mode 
[*] Fixed issue where line enemies spawned bottom formation when they should spawn in top formation
[*] Fixed bug where the light from the enemies would blink sometimes
[*] Hopefully reduced stuttering a bit*
[/list]

* It still stutters sometimes most likely due to garbage collection of allocations I have no practical control over. Tip to aspiring game developers: Don't use Java or C# or any other garbage collected language, it comes with false promises and does not make making games easier.

notes.title: Waves game mode and a new enemy
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40513164/516c4f33e6291b0b67ca9058c8bfbeddda711058.gif[/img]

The development of Dextram continues. Since the last post about the graphics improvements I have worked on a new game mode called waves. It plays the same as the normal game, but with a different spawning behavior for the enemies. Instead of spawning at random locations they spawn in predetermined spawning patterns. This allows for spawning more enemies at the same time without it becoming impossible to handle and allows for a little bit more strategic playstyle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40513164/c759da928732339184d91860203f7257e9b75525.gif[/img]

I have also created a new enemy type which patrols from edge to edge, it was designed to specifically fit well into the new game mode. You can see more clips from the new mode and the new enemy in a new gameplay trailer on youtube: [previewyoutube=ine4v24mv0U;full][/previewyoutube]


And don't forget to Wishlist the game if you haven't already!

notes.title: Introducing Dextram
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40513164/8f71321a7929b2941b3a6165ebbe07055985aa6b.png[/img]

Dextram is an upcoming arcade shoot 'em up game with a twist. There is no shooting, and you can only turn right. It is based on a mobile game I created a while back called Touch to Turn. For the PC Steam release I have completely remade the graphics and art style of the game and more power-ups, enemies and game modes will be added as well. If you want to follow the development of the game you can follow me on Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/gurkbanan]https://twitter.com/gurkbanan[/url] 

Here I post some short video clips showcasing what I am working on every once in a while.

Or you can subscribe to my Youtube channel: [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCGCHhFjRwHr7iYLGeVgkEJw]https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCGCHhFjRwHr7iYLGeVgkEJw[/url] 
Here I will shortly start posting devlogs on the game.
